# Evidence-Based Completion Checklist: Supervised Autonomous Loop

**Purpose**: Formal reviewer gate for requirements that separate agent claims, artifacts, evidence,
independent review, and deterministic verification
**Created**: 2026-08-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) and [data model](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Completion Semantics

- [x] CHK001 Is `CLAIMED_COMPLETE` explicitly the strongest state an agent claim can produce, with no alternate direct path to `VERIFIED`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022; Data Model §Task transitions]
- [x] CHK002 Is the Verification Engine the sole authorized actor for `VERIFIED`, and is its decision recorded as a versioned evaluation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022/FR-032]
- [x] CHK003 Are artifact existence, integrity, provenance, and Git revision binding distinguished from evidence that the artifact satisfies a requirement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030; Data Model §Artifact/Evidence]
- [x] CHK004 Are every required evidence class and its acceptable status specified by a versioned VerificationPolicy rather than hard-coded in a UI or backend? [Completeness, Data Model §VerificationPolicy]

## Independence and Ground Truth

- [x] CHK005 Is reviewer independence defined by a different organizational lineage, including rejection of same-lineage or self-review evidence? [Measurability, Spec §FR-031/SC-009]
- [x] CHK006 Are critical review diversity requirements distinguished from the minimum fake-backend slice so missing provider diversity does not falsely block or satisfy lineage independence? [Consistency, Constitution §X; Spec §Exclusions]
- [x] CHK007 Are Git revision, test result, artifact hash, approval, and reconciliation treated as ground truth while messages and backend claims remain non-authoritative? [Consistency, Constitution §VII/VIII; Spec §FR-032]
- [x] CHK008 Are evidence producer, observed time, source hash, expected revision, and stale/mismatch semantics defined clearly enough for deterministic assessment? [Clarity, Data Model §Evidence]

## Failure and Results Coverage

- [x] CHK009 Are missing, failing, stale, mismatched-revision, altered-artifact, and blocking-finding cases each required to prevent verification? [Coverage, Spec §FR-033/SC-004]
- [x] CHK010 Is behavior defined when evidence changes while Quality is reviewing, including whether a fresh evaluation and expected revision are required? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases; Gap]
- [x] CHK011 Are approval evidence and human release authority kept distinct so approving one fixture effect cannot approve verification or a future release? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016/FR-032; Release Model §Release gate]
- [x] CHK012 Are the acceptance percentages for positive and negative evidence fixtures objective and exhaustive enough to catch false-positive verification? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK013 Does the Results requirement define how verified, unverified, blocked, failed, and cancelled tasks are labeled without presenting non-verified work as done? [Clarity, Spec §FR-034/SC-011]
- [x] CHK014 Is requirement-to-test/evidence coverage included in the final evidence bundle with stable identifiers and unresolved findings? [Traceability, Quickstart §Evidence bundle]
- [x] CHK015 Are artifact/evidence retention and deletion deliberately linked to OD-006 instead of silently specified or omitted as an implementation default? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions; Open Decisions §OD-006]

## Notes

- Independent requirements review accepted all 15/15 items on 2026-08-31.
- Evidence-quality review here is not the same as executing the future Verification Engine.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify markers.
